Description: A commonly seen Nanotrasen frigate, usually manufactured with some sort of dual cargo-sci department. The hull itself is highly modular and well equipped, although rather slow due to it's poor thrust-to-mass ratio. Nontheless the Squab-Class continues to maintain Nanotrasen's interests in the region, while providing fairly good conditions to its employees.

Modules.Name: Robotics Lab
Modules.Description: Squab's classic Lab designed for field research and robotics: Two fabricators and a basic lathe setup to keep you going.

Modules.Name: Medical Lab
Modules.Description: A chemistry lab with some spare medical supplies designed for pharmaceutical research.

Modules.Name: Nanite Lab
Modules.Description: A nanite research compartment for quick access to nanite technology and research.

Modules.Name: Mecha Ripley
Modules.Description: Squab's basic mecha setup: A mining ripley with some spare repair tool, a recharging station and a crate full of mining equipment.

Modules.Name: Mecha Paddy
Modules.Description: A security upgrade for your vessel: A high-speed, low-drag Paddy mecha to keep your assistants in check.

Modules.Name: Extra gear bay
Modules.Description: A small section of the cargobay that includes some extra mining gear for your adventures.

Modules.Name: AI core
Modules.Description: Squab's default AI core setup designed for the robotics lab.

Modules.Name: Plumbing storage
Modules.Description: A basic storage compartment for medical plumbing gear.

Modules.Name: Science Director
Modules.Description: A bedroom for the science director with a research modsuit and a filled locker. An experimental prototype resides on the table.

Modules.Name: Medical Director
Modules.Description: Medical Director's quarters containing a modsuit, a compact defibrillator and a filled locker for medical research.
